text: {"lessons":["Selling B and E at a gain did not prevent me from buying them back later at higher prices; I’ll avoid treating a realized profit as proof that my timing was good.","My account rose for several periods and then fell, so I’ll remember that short-term gains and losses are not reliable signals of what comes next.","Before adding positions, I’ll check how each trade affects my overall portfolio and cash, rather than buying simply because a stock has fallen or I feel I should act."]}
